visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) In a brightly lit commercial gym, a muscular man with dyed blonde hair and tattoos on his forearms is looking into a mirror, touching his abdomen with concern and checking his physique. A second person is partially visible from a first-person perspective, showing a shoulder and arm in the foreground. Captions are visible at the top and bottom of the frame. (2) Inside a well-lit locker room or bathroom with tiled walls, the man examines his beard and jawline in the mirror with a vain or curious expression, sticking his tongue out playfully while touching his chin. The lighting is bright and even. No other people are visible in this specific setting. (3) Returning to the gym environment, the man is shown in a close-up holding a black smartphone, scrolling through a gallery of professional bodybuilding competition photos of himself. He looks focused and slightly obsessed. The background shows various fitness equipment like racks and benches. (4) Standing amidst heavy weight machines, the man looks down at his own body with a deeply frustrated and disappointed expression. He flexes both arms intensely while looking into the distance, as if judging his own progress. The gym background is slightly blurred but recognizable. (5) The man approaches a white digital body composition scale in a corner of the gym. He looks around nervously before stepping onto the platform with a worried and anxious face. He stares down at the display, reacting with distress to the numbers shown. (6) In a lounge area with black metal gridded decor, the man holds a beige plastic food container containing a pre-prepared meal. He looks at the box with a mix of relief and intense hunger, gesturing with one hand on his hip while holding the food. (7) In a final close-up shot against a neutral white and grey wall, the man speaks directly to the audience with a professional demeanor. He points his finger toward the camera and uses emphatic hand gestures to emphasize his points. Large text overlays and digital sparkles appear on screen.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) A male voice speaks with a slightly whiny, anxious tone, expressing regret about eating too much over high-tempo, heavy-bass Phonk music. He laments about gaining weight while a rhythmic electronic beat with a strong, distorted bassline drives the high-energy atmosphere. No other sounds are present. (2) The same male voice shifts to a more self-assured, curious tone as he comments on his facial appearance while looking in a mirror. The background music maintains its aggressive electronic pulse and steady tempo, providing a consistent rhythmic bed for the narration without any distracting environmental noises. (3) A brief interaction occurs where a second, softer male voice asks a question from off-camera, followed by the main speaker's defensive and focused response. The Phonk BGM continues without interruption, maintaining its high-energy electronic texture and consistent percussive rhythm throughout the dialogue exchange. (4) The main male voice becomes dramatic and despairing, speaking with high vocal arousal about losing muscle mass and failing at competitions. The background music provides a constant, high-arousal environment with its repetitive and intense electronic beat, heightening the sense of theatrical frustration. (5) The speaker sounds increasingly distressed and panicked while checking his body weight, his voice rising in pitch and intensity. This is followed by a sharp transition in tone to a relieved and triumphant exclamation about finding a specific food item, while the BGM remains steady. (6) The final segment features the male voice adopting a professional, clear promotional tone, delivering an energetic marketing pitch. Several digital UI sound effects, including a 'ding' and 'sparkle' chime, accompany the appearance of on-screen text overlays, while the background music persists at the same tempo.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: To humorously portray the stereotypical traits and daily anxieties of a bodybuilder, such as body dysmorphia and meal prep obsession, in order to promote 'Onion' brand meal prep services as a convenient solution.

endorsement_analysis.endorsementCues: Direct verbal pitch and on-screen slogan '餐餐吃洋蔥' (Eat Onion every meal) with a discount coupon offer.
